// The reference table of the number-format renderer: a format code, a value and the text Excel
// displays for it. `tests/format.rs` renders every row and compares the text.
//
// Each line is `code|value|text|`. The last `|` ends the text, so a trailing space shows.
// A value is a number, `t:` and a text, or `b:true` or `b:false`. Every row is in the 1900 date
// system and the `en` locale. The cases follow the shapes of SheetJS SSF's tests (Apache-2.0).
//
// General
General|0|0|
General|1|1|
General|-1|-1|
General|0.1|0.1|
General|-0.5|-0.5|
General|1234.5678|1234.5678|
General|0.333333333333333|0.333333333|
General|0.30000000000000004|0.3|
General|123456.789012|123456.789|
General|12345678901|12345678901|
General|123456789012|1.23457E+11|
General|0.0001|0.0001|
General|0.0000000001234|1.234E-10|
General|100000000000000000000|1E+20|
General|t:Shop|Shop|
// Digit placeholders and rounding
0|1234.5|1235|
0|2.5|3|
0|-2.5|-3|
0.00|2.675|2.68|
0.00|0.005|0.01|
0.00|-1.5|-1.50|
#.##|0.5|.5|
#.##|12|12.|
0.0#|1.5|1.5|
0.0#|1.234|1.23|
0.???|1.5|1.5  |
??0.0|1.5|  1.5|
000|7|007|
00000|1234|01234|
000-00-0000|123456789|123-45-6789|
// Thousands, scaling and percent
#,##0|1234567|1,234,567|
#,##0|999|999|
#,##0|0|0|
#,##0.00|1234567.891|1,234,567.89|
#,##0.00|-1234.5|-1,234.50|
#,##0,|1234567|1,235|
#,##0,,|1234567890|1,235|
0.0,," M"|1234567|1.2 M|
0%|0.25|25%|
0.00%|0.12345|12.35%|
// Scientific
0.00E+00|12345|1.23E+04|
